columns.name: TimeGenerated
columns.description: Event time, derived from the Airlock datetime field

columns.name: Checkpoint
columns.description: Event checkpoint identifier for incremental retrieval

columns.name: EventDateTime
columns.description: Timestamp of execution event

columns.name: ExecutionType
columns.description: Execution type code (0-18): Trusted, Blocked, Audit, OTP, etc.

columns.name: ExecutionTypeName
columns.description: Readable execution type, for example Blocked Execution or Trusted Publisher Execution

columns.name: Username
columns.description: User account that executed the file

columns.name: Hostname
columns.description: Host machine name where execution occurred

columns.name: NetDomain
columns.description: Network domain of the host

columns.name: FileName
columns.description: Name of the executed file. The Poll and SaaS connectors report the full path here; the Push connector reports the base name and populates FilePath

columns.name: FilePath
columns.description: Directory containing the executed file, with a trailing separator (populated by the Push connector only)

columns.name: ParentPolicy
columns.description: Parent policy group name, for example Airlock Groups

columns.name: PolicyName
columns.description: Airlock policy name applied to the execution

columns.name: PolicyVersion
columns.description: Version of the Airlock policy applied, for example v485

columns.name: PolicyId
columns.description: Identifier of the Airlock policy applied (populated by the Push connector only)

columns.name: CommandLine
columns.description: Command line arguments passed to the executed file

columns.name: Publisher
columns.description: Code signing publisher of the executed file

columns.name: ParentProcess
columns.description: Parent process name

columns.name: GrandparentProcess
columns.description: Grandparent process name

columns.name: SHA256
columns.description: SHA-256 file hash

columns.name: MD5
columns.description: MD5 file hash

columns.name: SHA128
columns.description: SHA-1 file hash (Airlock legacy field name sha128)

columns.name: SHA384
columns.description: SHA-384 file hash (populated by the Poll and SaaS connectors only)

columns.name: SHA512
columns.description: SHA-512 file hash (populated by the Poll and SaaS connectors only)

columns.name: IPAddress
columns.description: Public IP address of the host

columns.name: LocalIPAddress
columns.description: Local IP address of the host

columns.name: ExtensionId
columns.description: Browser extension identifier

columns.name: ExtensionName
columns.description: Browser extension name

columns.name: ExtensionType
columns.description: Extension type (1=CRX, 2=XPI)

columns.name: ExtensionBrowser
columns.description: Browser type (1=Chrome, 2=Firefox, 3=Edge)

columns.name: MetaruleId
columns.description: Identifier of the metarule that matched the execution, when applicable (populated by the Push connector only)

columns.name: PackageId
columns.description: Identifier of the package the file belongs to, when applicable (populated by the Push connector only)

columns.name: ConnectorName
columns.description: Connector Friendly Name assigned during connector setup
